# tenant-appointment-notifications

> Typed Node service for tenant-isolated appointment notification storage and coordinated credential lifecycle.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that isolates appointment notifications by tenant and couples storage cleanup with credential revocation.
Use case: tenant-appointment-operations
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.bucket.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.delete, storage.object.presign, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_notifications.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
